text_block_list.text:
One day, Nishino Flower came to visit the 
Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Please listen! The carrots in the field 
you looked at before have finally grown 
nicely!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So tomorrow after school, we're 
holding a tasting party! I really want you 
to come too, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So many people helped me out while those 
carrots were growing.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So I'd love for everyone to enjoy eating 
the harvested carrots♪

The next day. Since I was invited, I 
decided to help out with the harvest. At 
our meeting spot—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you're early! I thought I was going 
to be the first one here!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh...? There's someone else over 
there—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hwahaha! I have been waiting for you, 
Nishino Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman! What are you doing here so 
early?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I heard about the state of the field from 
Tazuna! My word, truly magnificent! A 
splendid field indeed!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To raise them to this point must have 
required truly painstaking effort!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hard work is often difficult for others to 
see from the outside. Yet, even with no 
one watching, you did what needed to be 
done—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And the fruit of that labor is these 
vibrant carrots! Hence, utmost praise! 
Truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Doing what needed to be done, even without 
anyone watching...?
choice_data_list: Where have I heard that before—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Right then, I caught sight of an "older 
girl" working in this field!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
During such a quiet time when everyone 
else was still fast asleep, she was doing 
her best all by herself—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her back, it felt like she was 
teaching me that you just have to do what 
needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Don't tell me that "older girl" was—!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, to think someone was watching me 
back then! To be called an admired "older 
girl" is truly an honor!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The honor is all mine...! I've always had 
you as my role model.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I kept working hard in the field so I 
wouldn't bring shame to that "older girl"!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Did I... manage to get even a little bit 
closer to you...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Nnnnnngh... Without question!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For just behold!! Look upon this contrast 
of lively green and vivid orange!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
One can tell without even tasting! Just 
how much love went into raising these 
carrots!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With patience and devoted care, you never 
gave up, finally arriving at today's 
harvest!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I commend your marvelous effort once more! 
You are already a splendid "older girl" 
yourself!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Chairwoman...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy... I'm truly glad I worked so 
hard...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, y-you're right!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um! We're planning to have everyone taste 
these carrots after school today...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you come join us too, 
Chairwoman?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've come up with so many dishes so 
everyone can enjoy the flavors!

And so, at the tasting party held in the 
cafeteria after school—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hawaaa~~ It smells so good in here~~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's a warm aroma that reminds me of 
home-cooked meals. Simmered dishes... 
namasu... deep-fried soaked veggies...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishment! To think so many people 
would gather here!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so happy. This is all thanks to 
the carrots growing so splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, there are still plenty of 
seconds available. Walk-ins are very 
welcome too♪

Lured by the sweet aroma of carrots, horse 
girls continued to gather one after 
another. Thus, the tasting party concluded 
in great success!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yo! I'm here, Flower! You're serving up 
some good eats today, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I heard it's a variety with remarkably 
high nutritional value. I'd certainly like 
to learn a thing or two today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! Please eat as much as you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Even so, eating such fine dishes 
among just ourselves almost feels a bit 
wasteful...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that won't be a problem! There's 
someone else I've invited too—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah!

And so, everyone relished the carrots 
grown by Nishino Flower to their hearts' 
content.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I'd really love to keep doing 
it...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I kept borrowing 
this garden plot?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! In fact, after seeing such 
marvelous results, I was about to bow my 
head and make the request myself!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hence, my petition! Would you accept the 
official role of "Garden Minister"?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Garden Minister"...? You mean... me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll do my absolute best! So that 
everyone can eat lots of nutritious, 
delicious vegetables!

Having received the recognition of someone 
she admired, Nishino Flower beamed with 
newfound motivation. I warmly watched over 
her growing, reliable back.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! Could it be that you have 
already decided on what to grow next?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Actually, I was hoping to try growing 
strawberries next—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: S-Strawberries...?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Fully supported! In fact, highly and 
enthusiastically recommended!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I have passionate expectations for 
exceptionally sweet, big, plump berries!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll do my best so I can bring 
you some as a treat, Madam Chairwoman!

And so, Nishino Flower continued to have a 
lively gardening discussion with the "big 
sister" she admired.
